ranking.rule: A variable is left out of the ranking, and reported as one of Earth's limits, when the median of the target's cells lies outside the whole range of Earth's reference population in physical units.

reference_population.definition: Ice-free, water-free land with every used dimension present. Antarctica enters as exposed rock; the ice sheet is excluded from ranking.

null_test.statistic: minimum di_combined over the Earth sample

rasters.name: rank_combined
rasters.units: rank among reference cells, 0 = best on Earth

earths_limits.numbers: Moon 1.62 m/s2, Mars 3.72 m/s2, Earth 9.81 m/s2
earths_limits.invalidates: Regolith mechanics, dust settling, drill reaction forces, lander dynamics, human gait and load testing

earths_limits.numbers: Moon ~1e-12 bar, Mars ~0.006 bar, Earth 1 bar
earths_limits.invalidates: Vacuum seals, boiling points, convective heat rejection, anything pneumatic

earths_limits.numbers: No global magnetic field and no thick atmosphere on either target
earths_limits.invalidates: Electronics tolerance, crew dose planning, material ageing

earths_limits.numbers: Lunar day about 29.5 Earth days; Mars 24.66 h
earths_limits.invalidates: Power and thermal cycling on the Moon; Mars is close enough that the swing is ranked

earths_limits.numbers: Earth's surfaces are water- and life-altered; the targets' are not
earths_limits.invalidates: Grain shape, soil chemistry, mineral alteration products

limits: Chance test: not significant, p = 0.941. Control (Atacama patch): FAILED -- this test has no power; do not read p as evidence, p = 0.711. Ranking system: earth_reachable_only. The team named all_variables the main result on 14 November 2026; this file is the second view. The index is a cell's mean distance to EVERY cell of the target, so it measures likeness to the region as a whole; the target's own spread is 3.0286 and an index above 1 is expected for a varied target. Read ranks, not index values. With this score a patch that is uniform inside scores lower than a varied one whatever Earth looks like, so p partly measures how uniform the target is. A best 1% exists for every target: it is an order, not a quality. Variables no Earth cell reaches are reported in run.ranking.out_of_range and do not rank. Composition is a weak variable at both ends (a rock-class lookup on Earth, 60 km blocks on the Moon). Mars temperatures are modelled, not measured. One cell is 6 to 7 km across; nothing here describes boulders or soil. Every site is a partial analog: see earths_limits.
